findings.page: PDF p.21 (printed xvii), PDF p.27 (printed 3), PDF p.79 (printed 55)
findings.chapter: Preface (Reading conventions) / Ch. 1 (§1.1.2) / Ch. 4 (§4.3 canonical box) — targets in Appendix A
findings.evidence: Preface, PDF p.21: "Appendix A numbers its own sections with a letter suffix, so Appendix A § 9A means Appendix A, the section labelled 9A; the appendix's figures carry A.N."  Ch. 1, PDF p.27: "all accessed 2026-08-30, the book's evidence cutoff; Appendix A §10)".  Ch. 4, PDF p.79: "Appendix A's §A.7 (Fig A.2, vendor-relative KV/compute ratios) is its deliberate relaxation, not a correction."  Preface, PDF p.21 again: "a superseding re-verification of the DeepSeek model-service status (Appendix A, A.3) is carried under v20260913+addendum-20261101" and "Appendix A, A.6 carries a boxed 2026-09-27 capability probe".
findings.issue: Appendix A sections are referenced in four mutually incompatible forms: '§9A' (letter suffix on a bare number, the form the Preface defines), '§10' (bare number, no letter suffix — violates the stated convention), '§A.7' (figure-style 'A.N' label applied to a section), and 'A.3' / 'A.6' (figure-style labels used for sections with no § marker at all). The Preface explicitly fixes one convention and the body then departs from it three different ways. A reader following 'Appendix A §10' or 'Appendix A's §A.7' cannot tell whether these denote the section labelled 9A-style, a numbered section, or a figure, and 'Fig A.2' sits next to '§A.7' inside the same phrase, compounding the ambiguity.
findings.fix_instruction: Pick one Appendix A labelling scheme and apply it to the appendix itself and to every reference. Either (a) label appendix sections 1, 2, 3 … and reference them as 'Appendix A §3', 'Appendix A §7', 'Appendix A §10' while figures keep 'Fig A.N'; or (b) keep letter-suffixed sections ('9A') and reference them as 'Appendix A §9A' only. Remove the '§' from the two bare-figure-style references ('Appendix A, A.3' → 'Appendix A §3' or the correct section label; 'Appendix A, A.6' likewise) and fix the Preface sentence to state the single rule, including whether 'A.N' is figures-only.
